page.notes: Right margin notes, in order: "Pighius in negotio de iustificatione sensit cum Lutheranus" (the last word reads "Lutheranū" and is doubtful); "Vbi nunc Pontificii, consensum veteris in rebus fidei, quem tantopere iactare [?] solent?"
